meta.title: Session tool disclosure
meta.description: Per-Agent tool disclosure across presets. Keeps existing configurable core tools visible; tool_search discovers inherited Host/preset capabilities and tool_activate selects original schemas for the next step. Agent-private registrations remain unchanged. Preserves conditions, permissions and native/PTC execution. Restores session-local state without inheriting parent grants. Not a workflow controller or security sandbox. Version 0.1.0 passes 31 offline checks; model A/B and GUI remain unverified.
